packages.name: MetaTrader 5
packages.description: MetaTrader 5 terminal runtime with the Nile bridge.

versions.notes: NileTrade 1.7.0: tick values on each quote (nile #805); a bracket protection whose position closed before binding ends instead of staying active (nile #796); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-e66c718.

NileTrade 1.6.0: pip size per instrument for stops in pips, stops inside the spread refused before sending (stops_invalid), route rules applied to route orders (nile #780, #779); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-253a447.

NileTrade 1.5.0: closed positions report why they closed (stop out, close in an MT5 terminal, besides order, SL, TP and outside the platform) (nile #669); includes the stops-in-units fix of main-102c6ef (#666); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-102c6ef.

Stops in units (money, % balance, pips, points) reach nile-risk on the trade socket again: Edit SL/TP keeps converted stops and new orders get them (nile #666); Go 1.27.4; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-bb07f81.
Real accounts allowed (ADR-055: the demo-only check in NileTrade is withdrawn; stages are checked by the Control Plane), nile 1.2.1-alpha.1; Wine 11.20. Supersedes main-213a8d4.

packages.description: Python 3.12 runtime for Nile strategies, run as a separate container next to a trading terminal.

versions.notes: First Python strategy runtime (Python 3.12), built from nile main 010d18af (nile 1.2.0-alpha.1).

packages.name: Interactive Brokers (beta)
packages.description: Interactive Brokers runtime: one container per account with nile-risk, the Nile bridge and the GPL TWS API shim. IB Gateway is downloaded on your server at first start and checked against pinned hashes.

versions.notes: Beta, unverified: not yet run against a real IB account. Stocks only. The gateway API port follows the trading mode (4002 paper, 4001 live); only these ports are accepted and the port check proves sign-in (nile #941). Gateway 10.50.1h, TWS API 1050.02, ib-tws-shim v0.2.0. Supersedes main-9797201e.

Beta, unverified: not yet run against a real IB account. Stocks only. ib-login clicks Paper Log In, accepts the paper-account warning and logs which gateway ports answer (nile #939). Gateway 10.50.1h, TWS API 1050.02, ib-tws-shim v0.2.0. Supersedes main-a0bc89fc.

Beta, unverified: not yet run against a real IB account. Stocks only. ib-login gives the gateway, shim and installer JVMs user.home and logs the gateway exit status (nile #937). Gateway 10.50.1h, TWS API 1050.02, ib-tws-shim v0.2.0. Supersedes main-5c5f7f8b.

Beta, unverified: not yet run against a real IB account. Stocks only. The IB bridge keeps its state in /var/lib/nile-venue by default; the supervisor passes the state and lease folders (nile #933). Gateway 10.50.1h, TWS API 1050.02, ib-tws-shim v0.2.0. Supersedes main-6b61e510.

Beta, unverified: not yet run against a real IB account. Stocks only. IB state folder without setgid (mode 1770) with a startup check (nile #930). Gateway 10.50.1h, TWS API 1050.02, ib-tws-shim v0.2.0. Supersedes main-9be83586.

Beta, unverified: not yet run against a real IB account. Stocks only. Gateway 10.50.1h, TWS API 1050.02, ib-tws-shim v0.2.0; every order passes nile-risk, the agent closes the gateway API port (nile #903, #907, #909, #918).
